column1: # The physical-plan packages of the registry lint (//:fs_registry_deps,
# tools/build/lint/defs.bzl, fs_registry_deps): the packages under src/ that
# must never depend on komira_fs_registry, directly or through another
# package. One row per prefix or package, tab-separated:
# <prefix|package> <name> <why it is physical-plan execution>. A package
# whose name starts with a `prefix` row's name is in the set; a `package` row
# names one more that no prefix covers, and must name a package of the tree
# that no prefix covers, or the row fails the build. A new physical-plan
# package that matches no prefix gets a `package` row here.
